summary: Conditional resource cleanup: when the flag byte at this+0x8 is nonzero and the DWORD pointer at this+0 is non-null, frees the embedded pointer via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Then, if parameter a2 bit 0 is set, frees the object itself (this). Returns this unchanged in every path. Structural twin of ConditionalDestructor_46f0 (004646f0).

operations.description: Guard on the byte at this+0x8 being nonzero combined with the DWORD at this+0 being non-null; the embedded-pointer free runs only when both hold.
Free the embedded pointer stored at this+0 via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Guard on (a2 & 1) != 0: the self-free runs only when parameter bit 0 is set.
Free the object itself (this) via FreeWrapper_7bcf.

unresolved: The owning class and the meaning of the flag byte at this+0x8 are unknown; the flag likely tracks whether the embedded pointer at this+0 owns allocated memory.
The meaning of a2 bit 0 (self-delete flag) as a convention across the two callers is not established.
A2 bit mask 1 is read from the raw source; no dedicated packet guard evidence documents it.
